subject: general
question: Two numbers A and B are, respectively, 20% and 56% more than a third number C. The ratio of the numbers A to B is:
solution:
Given:

A and B are, respectively, 20% and 56% more than a third number C.

Concept used:

Application of Percentage

Calculation:

Hence,

A = C + C × 20% = 1.2C

B = C + C × 56% = 1.56C

Hence,

A : B

⇒ 1.2C : 1.56C</p&g
